test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Don’t put all your eggs in the same basket.

options.text: Don’t invest in loss making propositions
Don’t concentrate all your resources in one place
Don’t share your wealth with others
Don’t buy too many things at one time

solution:
The correct answer is__** Don’t concentrate all your resources in one place.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's understand the meaning of the given Idiom: 
 
• **Don’t put all your eggs in the same basket:** This is a piece of advice which means that one should not concentrate all efforts and resources in one area as one could lose everything.
 
 
• Mr. Tan’s financial adviser urged him to be careful and **not put all his eggs in one basket** by investing all his money on stocks.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**
